entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. The instant application for anticipatory bail has been filed by the petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with Gopalpur Patna P.S. Case no. 350 of 2019 instituted for the offence under Sections 147, 148, 406, 420, 504, 506 and 341 of the Indian Penal Code.

entities.text: Gopalpur Patna P.S. Case no. 350 of 2019
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The case of the prosecution based on complaint is that the complainant has given Rs. 50 lakhs to Shiv Bachan Rai, father of the petitioner for purchasing of piece of land.
It is further alleged that when he requested to execute the sale deed, they did not pay heed.
It is further alleged that on 14.11.2019, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.83041 of 2024(2) dt.12-12-2024 the complaint was being abused and was threatened.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that petitioner is innocent and has falsely been implicated in connection with the present case.

During the course of argument, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that from perusal of the agreement of token money and from agreement to sale, it will transpire that he is not a party in both of the agreement.

Neither he is Vinay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12786290/
1 witness nor he has taken money from the complainant.

entities.text: Vinay Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Money, if any, has been taken by his father.
5. Learned APP appearing for the State opposed the prayer of bail of the petitioner.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case as stated above, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender in connection with Gopalpur Patna P.S. Case no. 350 of 2019, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Patna, subject to the conditions as laid down under Patna High Court CR.
